251  @Test
252  public void testCacheCost() {
253    conf.set(HConstants.BUCKET_CACHE_PERSISTENT_PATH_KEY, "/tmp/prefetch.persistence");
254    CacheAwareLoadBalancer lb = newCacheAwareBalancer(conf);
255    CacheAwareLoadBalancer.CacheAwareCostFunction costFunction =
256      lb.new CacheAwareCostFunction(conf);
257
258    for (int test = 0; test < clusterRegionCacheRatioMocks.length; test++) {
259      int[][] clusterRegionLocations = clusterRegionCacheRatioMocks[test];
260      MockClusterForCacheCost cluster = new MockClusterForCacheCost(clusterRegionLocations);
261      costFunction.prepare(cluster);
262      double cost = costFunction.cost();
263      assertEquals(expectedCacheCost[test], cost, 0.01);
264    }
265  }

267  /**
268   * When block-cache persistence, cold regions (below
269   * {@link CacheAwareLoadBalancer#LOW_CACHE_RATIO_FOR_RELOCATION_KEY}) together with RS-reported
270   * block-cache free bytes inflate plausible best placement so weighted cache cost crosses
271   * {@code minCostNeedBalance}; {@link StochasticLoadBalancer#needsBalance} returns true even with
272   * evenly spread region-count skew.
273   */
274  @Test
275  public void testNeedsBalanceWhenLowCacheRatioRegionsAndFreeBlockCacheSpace() {
276    conf.set(HConstants.BUCKET_CACHE_PERSISTENT_PATH_KEY, "/tmp/prefetch.persistence");
277    CacheAwareLoadBalancer lb = newCacheAwareBalancer(conf);
278    int regionSizeMb = 64;
279    long cacheFreeInBytes = regionSizeMb * 1024L * 1024L;
280    // simulates a cache ratio lower than
281    // CacheAwareLoadBalancer.LOW_CACHE_RATIO_FOR_RELOCATION_DEFAULT
282    float simulatedCacheRatio = 0.1f;
283    Map<ServerName, List<RegionInfo>> clusterServers =
284      mockClusterServersUnsorted(new int[] { 1, 1 }, 1);
285    List<RegionInfo> regions = new ArrayList<>();
286    clusterServers.values().forEach(regions::addAll);
287    List<ServerName> serversList = getServersInInsertionOrder(clusterServers);
288    Map<ServerName, Long> blockCacheFree = new HashMap<>();
289    blockCacheFree.put(serversList.get(0), 0L);
290    blockCacheFree.put(serversList.get(1), cacheFreeInBytes);
291    BalancerClusterState cluster = new BalancerClusterState(clusterServers,
292      buildRegionLoads(regions, simulatedCacheRatio, regionSizeMb), null, null,
293      Collections.emptyMap(), blockCacheFree);
294    lb.initCosts(cluster);
295    assertTrue(lb.needsBalance(
296      TableName.valueOf("testNeedsBalanceWhenLowCacheRatioRegionsAndFreeBlockCacheSpace"),
297      cluster));
298  }
299
300  /**
301   * Checks that needsBalance isn't true when regions report high cache ratios
302   */
303  @Test
304  public void testNeedsBalanceFalseWhenWarmRegionsDespiteFreeBlockCacheSpace() {
305    conf.set(HConstants.BUCKET_CACHE_PERSISTENT_PATH_KEY, "/tmp/prefetch.persistence");
306    CacheAwareLoadBalancer lb = newCacheAwareBalancer(conf);
307    int regionSizeMb = 64;
308    long cacheFreeInBytes = regionSizeMb * 1024L * 1024L;
309    Map<ServerName, List<RegionInfo>> clusterServers =
310      mockClusterServersUnsorted(new int[] { 1, 1 }, 1);
311    List<RegionInfo> all = new ArrayList<>();
312    clusterServers.values().forEach(all::addAll);
313    List<ServerName> serversList = getServersInInsertionOrder(clusterServers);
314    Map<ServerName, Long> blockCacheFree = new HashMap<>();
315    blockCacheFree.put(serversList.get(0), cacheFreeInBytes + 1024 * 1024);
316    blockCacheFree.put(serversList.get(1), cacheFreeInBytes + 1024 * 1024);
317    BalancerClusterState cluster =
318      new BalancerClusterState(clusterServers, buildRegionLoads(all, 1.0f, regionSizeMb), null,
319        null, Collections.emptyMap(), blockCacheFree);
320    lb.initCosts(cluster);
321    assertFalse(lb.needsBalance(
322      TableName.valueOf("testNeedsBalanceFalseWhenWarmRegionsDespiteFreeBlockCacheSpace"),
323      cluster));
324  }

326  private static CacheAwareLoadBalancer newCacheAwareBalancer(Configuration cfg) {
327    CacheAwareLoadBalancer lb = new CacheAwareLoadBalancer();
328    lb.setClusterInfoProvider(new DummyClusterInfoProvider(cfg));
329    lb.loadConf(cfg);
330    return lb;
331  }
332
333  private static Map<String, Deque<BalancerRegionLoad>>
334    buildRegionLoads(Collection<RegionInfo> regions, float cachedRatio, int regionSizeMb) {
335    RegionMetrics rm = mock(RegionMetrics.class);
336    when(rm.getReadRequestCount()).thenReturn(0L);
337    when(rm.getCpRequestCount()).thenReturn(0L);
338    when(rm.getWriteRequestCount()).thenReturn(0L);
339    when(rm.getMemStoreSize()).thenReturn(Size.ZERO);
340    when(rm.getStoreFileSize()).thenReturn(Size.ZERO);
341    when(rm.getRegionSizeMB()).thenReturn(new Size(regionSizeMb, Size.Unit.MEGABYTE));
342    when(rm.getCurrentRegionCachedRatio()).thenReturn(cachedRatio);
343
344    BalancerRegionLoad brl = new BalancerRegionLoad(rm);
345    Map<String, Deque<BalancerRegionLoad>> loads = new HashMap<>();
346    for (RegionInfo ri : regions) {
347      ArrayDeque<BalancerRegionLoad> dq = new ArrayDeque<>(1);
348      dq.add(brl);
349      loads.put(ri.getRegionNameAsString(), dq);
350      loads.put(ri.getEncodedName(), dq);
351    }
352    return loads;
353  }
354
355  private static List<ServerName>
356    getServersInInsertionOrder(Map<ServerName, List<RegionInfo>> cluster) {
357    return new ArrayList<>(cluster.keySet());
358  }
359
360  private class MockClusterForCacheCost extends BalancerClusterState {
361    private final Map<Pair<Integer, Integer>, Float> regionServerCacheRatio = new HashMap<>();
362
363    public MockClusterForCacheCost(int[][] regionsArray) {
364      // regions[0] is an array where index = serverIndex and value = number of regions
365      super(mockClusterServersUnsorted(regionsArray[0], 1), null, null, null, null, null);
366      Map<String, Pair<ServerName, Float>> oldCacheRatio = new HashMap<>();
367      for (int i = 1; i < regionsArray.length; i++) {
368        int regionIndex = i - 1;
369        for (int j = 1; j < regionsArray[i].length; j++) {
370          int serverIndex = j - 1;
371          float cacheRatio = (float) regionsArray[i][j] / 100;
372          regionServerCacheRatio.put(new Pair<>(regionIndex, serverIndex), cacheRatio);
373          if (cacheRatio > 0.0f && serverIndex != regionsArray[i][0]) {
374            // This is the historical cacheRatio value
375            oldCacheRatio.put(regions[regionIndex].getEncodedName(),
376              new Pair<>(servers[serverIndex], cacheRatio));
377          }
378        }
379      }
380      regionCacheRatioOnOldServerMap = oldCacheRatio;
381    }
382
383    @Override
384    protected float getRegionCacheRatioOnRegionServer(int region, int regionServerIndex) {
385      float cacheRatio = 0.0f;
386
387      // Get the cache ratio if the region is currently hosted on this server
388      if (regionServerIndex == regionIndexToServerIndex[region]) {
389        return regionServerCacheRatio.get(new Pair<>(region, regionServerIndex));
390      }
391
392      // Region is not currently hosted on this server. Check if the region was cached on this
393      // server earlier. This can happen when the server was shutdown and the cache was persisted.
394      // Search using the index name and server name and not the index id and server id as these
395      // ids may change when a server is marked as dead or a new server is added.
396      String regionEncodedName = regions[region].getEncodedName();
397      ServerName serverName = servers[regionServerIndex];
398      if (
399        regionCacheRatioOnOldServerMap != null
400          && regionCacheRatioOnOldServerMap.containsKey(regionEncodedName)
401      ) {
402        Pair<ServerName, Float> serverCacheRatio =
403          regionCacheRatioOnOldServerMap.get(regionEncodedName);
404        if (ServerName.isSameAddress(serverName, serverCacheRatio.getFirst())) {
405          cacheRatio = serverCacheRatio.getSecond();
406          regionCacheRatioOnOldServerMap.remove(regionEncodedName);
407        }
408      }
409      return cacheRatio;
410    }
411
412    @Override
413    int getRegionSizeMinusColdDataMB(int region) {
414      return 1;
415    }
416
417  }
